chunks.title: The Cap Bar
chunks.text: The Cap Bar is now open at 348 South Main Street, Memphis, Tennessee 38103. It's not just a hat shop, it's an experience! Custom hats designed and pressed while you wait, in about 10 minutes. Hundreds of patches, one-of-a-kind hats. Come see us on South Main. Directions are available through Google Maps from the Get directions button on the home page.

chunks.title: Store hours
chunks.text: Store hours: Monday – Friday 10:30 AM – 7 PM; Saturday 10 AM – 7 PM; Sunday 11 AM – 6 PM. The store is at 348 South Main Street, Memphis. These are the regular store hours listed on the website.

The contact page has a message form for questions, custom designs, group or event orders, and when you open. Sending the form opens your email app with your message ready to go. chunks.title: Contact
chunks.section: Questions, custom designs, group or event orders
chunks.text: Questions, custom designs, group or event orders: send a message and we'll get back to you. For custom hat or design ideas, group orders and event orders, use the contact page or email capbarexperience@outlook.com.

chunks.title: The Cap Bar experience
chunks.text: How it works at The Cap Bar. Every logo pattern is designed by hand ahead of time, so when you walk in, your hat is pressed and ready in about 10 minutes. Step 1: Pick your cap. Trucker, snapback, distressed cap or beanie. Try a few on, the fit matters. Step 2: Choose your design. Pick from hundreds of patches and signature designs, or bring your own idea and we'll design it with you. Step 3: Ready in 10 minutes. We press it at the customization station while you wait. You walk out wearing it.

chunks.title: The Cap Bar experience
chunks.text: Custom patch caps: choose from hundreds of patches and signature designs, or bring your own idea and the team will design it with you. Cap styles to start from are trucker, snapback, distressed cap or beanie. Every logo pattern is designed by hand ahead of time, so your hat is pressed in about 10 minutes at the customization station while you wait, and you walk out wearing it. The Cap Bar designs custom hats for adults and children.

chunks.title: Our story
chunks.text: The Cap Bar is a family oriented custom hat experience where creativity, individuality, and community come together under one roof. We design custom hats for both adults and children, giving customers the opportunity to create something on their own. From choosing their personal unique style and colors to selecting personalized details and finishing touches. Every customer gets to bring their creative vision to life on the spot. Our goal is to be more than a retail store. We want The Cap Bar to feel like a place where everyone is welcomed and instantly feels like family. Whether customers are shopping for themselves, creating matching family hats, celebrating a special occasion, or simply looking for a fun and creative experience.

chunks.title: Our story
chunks.text: The Cap Bar welcomes everyone like family: shopping for yourself, creating matching family hats, celebrating a special occasion, or just a fun creative experience. Custom hats are for both adults and children.

chunks.title: What customers say
chunks.text: What customers say (reviews published on the contact page): “The SnapBack hats are on fire 🔥! Quality caps & plus customer service”, RB. “Love my caps! I told them my concept and they created me a masterpiece. Plus the hats are very good quality”, Nicole Brown. “We ordered caps from The Trinity Collection for a family photo shoot. The hats were amazing. We got matching camouflage hats. The men wore the green version and the women wore the white & black camo’s”, Erica Ford. “Love & Peace Collection is so colorful! The colors pop and the trucker hats are so beautiful. Love them”, Samantha. “Love the Pretty & Spoiled Collection. It’s my favorite! Those pink hats are so cute”, Amber. “The Queen Bling hats are so creative! The hats are a very good & thick quality”, Bella T. “Quality & amazing caps along with great customer service! You’ve got a lifetime customer”, TJ.
